deadline.value: Apply by April 1, 2027 (the Faculty of Graduate Studies deadline for non-Canadian applicants for September entry; the department sets no earlier date).
deadline.quote: For September admission: | June 1 (Canadian applicants), April 1 (non-Canadian applicants)

also.quote: Many departments have their own deadlines, which can be much earlier than the above deadlines.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applications are reviewed only with a supervisor's support; contact faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants to graduate programs are strongly advised to establish personal contact with potential faculty supervisors before beginning the formal application process. | Applications must have the support of a supervisor to be reviewed.

funding.value: Students typically pay no tuition; living and research costs come mainly from supervisors' research grants.
funding.quote: Students do not typically pay tuition. Instead, support for the students’ living and research expenses comes mainly from supervisors’ research grants.
